name: Gusev · Columbia Hills (Spirit, Husband Hill – Home Plate)

speedMps.title: Apollo EVA walking: O2 use and speed
speedMps.note: "Oxygen use was about 0.16 lb/hr per 1000 BTU/hr"; "1560 BTU/hr at 3.5 km/hr" -> ~113 g/h = 0.031 g/s (o2GPerS). Emergency return "3.6 km/hr for periods of up to an hour" -> 1.0 m/s (speedMps). Apollo, Moon; transferred to Mars (1/6 g -> 0.38 g).
speedMps.credit: E. M. Jones, Apollo Lunar Surface Journal

emergencyO2G.title: Emergency O2 reserve (EMU Secondary Oxygen Package)
emergencyO2G.note: NASA EVA overview (NTRS 20140009556): the EMU SOP "provides a minimum of 30 minutes of emergency O2". Grams = 1800 s x 0.031 g/s = 55.8 -> 56 g. ISS suit, not a Mars suit.

time.title: EVA time limit
time.note: 3600 s: 1 h EVA for the demo (SPEC §7.4). For reference: EMU EVA up to 7 h (NTRS 20140009556).

o2.title: O2 available for this EVA
o2.note: 140 g: 1 h of walking at the Apollo rate after the 20% reserve (0.031 g/s x 3600 s / 0.8 = 112 / 0.8); decision #20.

dose.title: Radiation dose limit
dose.note: No per-EVA dose limit -> null -> budget status incomplete (SPEC §7.6).

layers.name: Terrain (DEM)
layers.method: mean of valid 1 m pixels per cell

layers.name: Hillshade (derived from DEM)
layers.method: hillshade at 1 m (sun 315 deg / 45 deg), area-weighted mean to 2048², contrast stretch p2–p98; not an image

legend.label: slope facing away from the sun

layers.name: Thermal IR night (THEMIS)
layers.method: WMTS tile, nearest per cell; linear stretch DN 150–250 (p2–p98) to colour ramp

legend.label: DN 150 · cooler at night (lower thermal inertia)
DN 250 · warmer at night (higher thermal inertia)

layers.name: Thermal IR day (THEMIS)
layers.method: WMTS tile, nearest per cell; linear stretch DN 133–236 (p2–p98) to colour ramp

layers.name: Slope (derived)
layers.method: Horn 3x3 at 1 m, max per cell

layers.name: Spirit traverse
layers.method: clip to bbox; elevation from grid

sources.title: Columbia Hills DEM 1 m (HiRISE stereo)
sources.note: Float32 TIFF via exportImage at 1 m (native 1.7e-5 deg ~ 1.01 m), nearest neighbour; mean of valid pixels per 10 m cell.

sources.title: Hillshade derived from the 1 m DEM
sources.note: No HiRISE orthomosaic of Gusev in Trek, so the texture is computed: hillshade (sun azimuth 315 deg, altitude 45 deg, Horn 3x3 at 1 m), area-weighted mean to 2048², linear stretch p2–p98 to 64–192. Shading of the DEM, not a photograph.

sources.title: Spirit traverse (Mars Trek)
sources.note: spirit_path polylines (lon/lat) clipped to bbox; elevation taken from elevation.f32 (10 m cell mean).

sources.title: Spirit waypoints (Mars Trek)
sources.note: Husband Hill and Home Plate set the bbox centre; waypoints inside the bbox check the base.

sources.title: THEMIS IR night, controlled mosaic 100 m v2 (Mars Odyssey)
sources.note: Trek WMTS PNG tiles, level 9 (~81 m/px), 1 tile(s); ~32x31 native pixels over the bbox, nearest per 10 m cell. 8-bit display brightness, not calibrated temperature. Display only, not an input to hazard (SPEC §8).
sources.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Arizona State University, Mars Odyssey THEMIS; Mars Trek

sources.title: THEMIS IR day, controlled mosaic 100 m v2 (Mars Odyssey)

sources.title: Hazard derived from slope
sources.note: hazard = min(1, slopeDeg / 25) x 0.5; NoData = 1. Test coefficients, not measured hazard.

sources.title: Habitat base
sources.note: Walkable cell nearest to bbox centre (lon 175.527995, lat -14.59911, midpoint of Trek spirit_waypoints Husband Hill and Home Plate) from which 5 of 6 Spirit waypoints in the bbox are reachable on slopes <= 25 deg; not a real habitat site.
